reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for model-driven, tiered conversation-context compaction with durable, searchable, auditable, and reversible session-log replacements.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供由模型驱动的分层上下文压缩、搜索、回顾与可逆恢复能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with model-driven, tiered context compaction plus searchable, reviewable, and reversible session-log restoration.

capabilities: Compacts conversation context into durable session-log replacement events
Restores compacted content through reversible decompression
Searches compacted and uncompacted session-log content
Adds model-facing context management tools and prompt guidance
